name: full-mern-auth-boilerplate
description: Full-stack MERN authentication boilerplate with NestJS backend and Next.js frontend

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:config
scripts.check: npm run check:bans && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:config: node --test scripts/config-transforms.test.mjs scripts/config-transforms.ports.test.mjs scripts/check-hard-bans.test.mjs scripts/guardrails/*.test.mjs scripts/eslint-policy.test.mjs scripts/check-contrast.test.mjs scripts/check-backend-build.test.mjs
scripts.test:config:all: node --test scripts/config-transforms.test.mjs scripts/config-transforms.ports.test.mjs scripts/check-hard-bans.test.mjs scripts/guardrails/*.test.mjs scripts/guardrails/*.slow.mjs scripts/eslint-policy.test.mjs scripts/check-contrast.test.mjs scripts/check-backend-build.test.mjs
